artboards.title: 13 · Rules panel, slides in from the right
D10 · Stop confirmation at 320 px, dark
B3 · Logo, favicon and install icons

annotations.text:
Dot states
• Small idle dot (dot token): not clickable
• Coral accent ring: valid start (MV-2, MV-4)
• Solid dot in the current player's color: selected Dot1
• Dashed ring in the current player's color: valid Dot2 neighbor (MV-3, MV-5)

Board shown at N=4, 48 px squares, on the lighter surface. Sample players: Оля (coral) and Богдан (teal) on Ukrainian screens, Ann and Bob on English ones.

Header on every screen: logo and game name, then theme, info (rules panel) and UA / EN (VR-18, I18N-3). Ukrainian is the default; screen 15 shows English.
Warm cream light here; dark versions of the main screens are in the D row.
All text comes from src/i18n/locales.
Spec: docs/dots-and-boxes/requirements.md, docs/visual-refresh/spec.md

Mobile layout (below 640 px wide)
• Board on top, centered; panel below at full width (MB-2)
• Squares stay 48 px while the board fits, then shrink to fit the screen, 24 px minimum (MB-3)
• Each dot is tappable across a whole square, up to 44 px (MB-4)
• Buttons are at least 44 px tall (MB-8)
• Header: theme, info and UA / EN buttons are 44 × 44 px (VR-21); the game name wraps at 320 px
• Rules: info button opens the rules panel full screen; closed by default, ✕ / Esc to close (VR-23..VR-28)
• Colors: 8 swatches, 4 per row (VR-32)
• Languages: Ukrainian by default; screen 14 shows English (I18N-2, I18N-5)

From 640 px up, the desktop layout on the Desktop page applies. Dark versions are in the D row.

Versus computer mode (spec: docs/computer-opponent/spec.md, issue #6)
• Game mode switch at the top of setup: Versus computer (default) | Two players (CM-1, CM-2, CM-6)
• Difficulty switch Easy | Normal, only in Versus computer, Normal by default (CM-5..7)
• Versus computer: the person enters name, color and size; the Opponent fieldset is read-only: robot + Computer with its automatic color (CM-4, CM-9)
• Robot icon: Material Symbols smart_toy as inline SVG, currentColor, aria-hidden (CM-13, CM-37)
• Computer's turn: robot + Computer in Turn, pulsing "Thinking…" in place of the hint, every dot idle (board locked), Stop still works (CM-14, CM-16, CM-17)
• Person's turn: "Your turn"; the computer's last line keeps a 4 px halo in its color until the person draws (CM-18, CM-19)
• Result: "You won!" or robot + "Computer won", winner first in the scores (CM-27)
• Sample person: Ярослава Петрук / Alexandra Brown, 15 characters, never cut; names wrap when space runs out (GS-1, GB-5)
• New text uses the proposed message keys listed in design.md

Versus computer mode (spec: docs/computer-opponent/spec.md, issue #6)
• Game mode switch at the top of setup: Versus computer (default) | Two players (CM-1, CM-2, CM-6)
• Difficulty switch Easy | Normal, only in Versus computer, Normal by default (CM-5..7)
• Versus computer: the person enters name, color and size; the Opponent fieldset is read-only: robot + Computer with its automatic color (CM-4, CM-9)
• Robot icon: Material Symbols smart_toy as inline SVG, currentColor, aria-hidden (CM-13, CM-37)
• Computer's turn: robot + Computer in Turn, pulsing "Thinking…" in place of the hint, every dot idle (board locked), Stop still works (CM-14, CM-16, CM-17)
• Person's turn: "Your turn"; the computer's last line keeps a 4 px halo in its color until the person draws (CM-18, CM-19)
• Result: "You won!" or robot + "Computer won", winner first in the scores (CM-27)
• Sample person: Ярослава Петрук / Alexandra Brown, 15 characters, never cut; names wrap when space runs out (GS-1, GB-5)
• New text uses the proposed message keys listed in design.md
• Phones: switches and buttons at least 44 px tall (CM-38, MB-8)

Visual refresh (spec: docs/visual-refresh/spec.md, issues #22, #23)
• Warm cream palette: semantic tokens with light and dark values, listed in design.md (VR-1, VR-12)
• Nunito, rounded corners (12 px controls, 20 px cards, 24 px rules panel edge) (VR-2, VR-3)
• Header: logo + name, theme, info, UA / EN; 44 px tap targets on phones (VR-18, VR-21)
• Rules panel replaces the Show/Hide rules toggle (VR-23..VR-29)
• Swatch picker replaces the color input; the computer takes the most different swatch (VR-32..VR-37)
• Logo combo 1, scheme-aware SVG favicon, install icons on a cream tile (VR-40..VR-43)
Approved prototype: game layout A, logo combo 1 (prototype branch deleted after the build).
